finding: The Phase-1 source-control assignment_matrix and the authoritative DOWNSTREAM_STATE phase1 assignments use different exact task-id strings for all seven downstream/optimizer roles compared. The mismatch is deterministic and exact; it is an identity/join risk, not evidence that role execution itself is invalid.
authority_resolution: O_CHAT_PARALLEL.coordination states that downstream assignments resolve via DOWNSTREAM_STATE phase1_full_pool_overlay plus the role entry. Therefore DOWNSTREAM_STATE task ids are authoritative for downstream receipts under the frozen tuple; this audit uses p1-repro-feasibility.

mechanical_result.reproducibility: exact from frozen repository config files

risk: If any Phase-1 proof-matrix consumer performs an exact task-id join against O_CHAT_PARALLEL.assignment_matrix instead of resolving the authoritative DOWNSTREAM_STATE assignment, a valid post-overlay downstream receipt can be rejected or treated as missing. The current controls require exact identity and fail-closed behavior, so an undocumented alias is not safely inferable.
non_claims: This does not show that the integrator currently performs the wrong join; no post-overlay integrator implementation artifact at the frozen head was available to prove that behavior.
This does not invalidate CLEAN-role task ids; the compared set is only downstream/optimizer roles.
This audit does not modify control files or prescribe a semantic task change.
safe_resolution_requirement: Consumers should bind downstream receipt assignment_task_id to the exact authoritative DOWNSTREAM_STATE role assignment, or the control plane should publish an explicit canonical id/alias mapping. Fuzzy equivalence between the two strings is not safe under the exact-identity contract.
exact_next_phase1_action: On a fresh future tuple, inspect the first post-overlay integrator proof-matrix artifact/receipt and mechanically verify which assignment-id authority it joins against. If it uses DOWNSTREAM_STATE exact ids, close this as a documentation/alias hazard; if it uses O_CHAT_PARALLEL matrix ids, reproduce the resulting false-missing cell and record the exact affected scope.
